description: Post a discussion comment on a work item. The comment is internal unless `clientVisible` is true, which shares it with the client on shared reports as it is written; to change a comment that is already posted use anyforge_share_work_item_comment. Requires `write` scope and an editor-capable key owner.

clientVisible.description: true shares the comment with the client on shared reports as it is posted. Omitted or false keeps it internal (the default).

name: anyforge_post_work_item_comment
title: Post work item comment
